verses.uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.indopak: قَدۡ اَفۡلَحَ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Qad aflahal mu'minoon
verses.saheeh: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
verses.khattab: Successful indeed are the believers
verses.jalalayn: Indeed (qad is for confirmation) prosperous, victorious, are the believers,
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan falaah payi hai iman laney walon ne jo

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَٰشِعُونَ
verses.indopak: الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ فِىۡ صَلَاتِهِمۡ خَاشِعُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Allazeena hum fee Salaatihim khaashi'oon
verses.saheeh: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive
verses.khattab: those who humble themselves in prayer
verses.jalalayn: those who in their prayers are humble,
verses.romanUrdu: Apni namaz mein khushu ikhtiyar karte hain (Salat with humility)

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عَنِ اللَّغۡوِ مُعۡرِضُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wallazeena hum 'anillaghwimu'ridoon
verses.saheeh: And they who turn away from ill speech
verses.khattab: those who avoid idle talk
verses.jalalayn: and who shun vain talk, and other [nonsense],
verses.romanUrdu: Laghviyat (vain things) se door rehte hain

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِلزَّكٰوةِ فَاعِلُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wallazeena hum liz Zakaati faa'iloon
verses.saheeh: And they who are observant of zakah
verses.khattab: those who pay alms-tax
verses.jalalayn: and who fulfil payment of alms,
verses.romanUrdu: Zakaat ke tareeqe par aamil hotey hain

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوۡجِهِمۡ حٰفِظُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wallazeena hum lifuroo jihim haafizoon
verses.saheeh: And they who guard their private parts
verses.khattab: those who guard their chastity
verses.jalalayn: and who guard their private parts, against what is unlawful,
verses.romanUrdu: Apni sharmgaahon ki hifazat karte hain

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا عَلٰٓى اَزۡوَاجِهِمۡ اَوۡ مَا مَلَـكَتۡ اَيۡمَانُهُمۡ فَاِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُوۡمِيۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Illaa 'alaaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aimaanuhum fa innahum ghairu maloomeen
verses.saheeh: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
verses.khattab: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame
verses.jalalayn: except from their spouses, that is, to their spouses, and what [slaves] their right hands possess, that is, concubines, for then they are not blameworthy, in having sexual intercourse with them.
verses.romanUrdu: Siwaye apni biwiyon ke aur un auraton ke jo unki milk e yameen mein hon (right hand posseses) ke unpar (mehfooz na rakhne mein) woh qabil e malamat nahin hain

verses.uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verses.indopak: فَمَنِ ابۡتَغٰى وَرَآءَ ذٰ لِكَ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡعٰدُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Famanib taghaa waraaa'a zaalika fa ulaaa'ika humul 'aadoon
verses.saheeh: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
verses.khattab: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors
verses.jalalayn: But whoever seeks [anything] beyond that, [intercourse with] wives and concubines, such as masturbation: those, they are transgressors, who have overstepped [the bounds] into what is not lawful for them.
verses.romanUrdu: Albatta jo uske alawa kuch aur chahein wahi zyadati karne waley hain

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِاَمٰنٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رَاعُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wallazeena hum li amaanaatihim wa 'ahdihim raa'oon
verses.saheeh: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
verses.khattab: ˹the believers are also˺ those who are true to their trusts and covenants
verses.jalalayn: And who are keepers of their trusts (may be read as plural, amānātihim, ‘their trusts’, or singular, amānatihim, ‘their trust’) and covenants, [made] between them, or between them and God, such as [the observance of] prayer and so on.
verses.romanUrdu: Apni amanaton (trusts) aur apne ahad o paiman (promises) ka paas rakhte hain

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عَلٰى صَلَوٰتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُوۡنَ ۘ
verses.transliteration: Wallazeena hum 'alaa Salawaatihim yuhaafizoon
verses.saheeh: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
verses.khattab: and those who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers
verses.jalalayn: And who are watchful of their prayers (may be read as plural, salawātihim, ‘their prayers’, or singular, salātihim, ‘their prayer’) observing them at their appointed times.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur apni namazon ki muhafizat (hifazat) karte hain

verses.uthmani: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verses.indopak: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡوَارِثُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Ulaaa'ika humul waarisoon
verses.saheeh: Those are the inheritors
verses.khattab: These are the ones who will be awarded
verses.jalalayn: Those, they are the inheritors, and none other than them,
verses.romanUrdu: Yahi log woh waris hain

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.indopak: الَّذِيۡنَ يَرِثُوۡنَ الۡفِرۡدَوۡسَ ؕ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Allazeena yarisoonal Firdawsa hum feehaa khaalidoon
verses.saheeh: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
verses.khattab: Paradise as their own. They will be there forever
verses.jalalayn: who shall inherit Paradise (al-firdaws), the name of a garden, the highest of the gardens of Heaven — wherein they will abide; herein is an allusion to the Return [in the Hereafter] and so it is fitting that the Beginning [of creation] should be mentioned next:
verses.romanUrdu: Jo miraas mein firdous payenge aur usmein hamesha rahenge

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍۢ مِّن طِينٍۢ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنۡ طِيۡنٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana min sulaalatim minteen
verses.saheeh: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
verses.khattab: And indeed, We created humankind from an extract of clay
verses.jalalayn: And, by God, We certainly created man, Adam, from an extraction (min sulālatin, derives from [the verbal expression] salaltu’l-shay’a mina’l-shay’, ‘I drew one thing out of another’, meaning, ‘I extracted it therefrom’) his [Adam’s] substance being, of clay (min tīnin is semantically connected to sulālatin, ‘an extraction’).
verses.romanUrdu: Humne Insaan ko mitti ke saatt (essence of clay) se banaya

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُطْفَةًۭ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍۢ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنٰهُ نُطۡفَةً فِىۡ قَرَارٍ مَّكِيۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: Summa ja'alnaahu nutfatan fee qaraarim makeen
verses.saheeh: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.
verses.khattab: then placed each ˹human˺ as a sperm-drop in a secure place
verses.jalalayn: Then We made him, namely, man, the progeny of Adam, a drop, a sperm-drop, in a secure lodging, which is the womb.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir usey ek mehfooz jaga tapki hui boondh mein tabdeel kiya

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَٰمًۭا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَٰمَ لَحْمًۭا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ خَلَقۡنَا النُّطۡفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقۡنَا الۡعَلَقَةَ مُضۡغَةً فَخَلَقۡنَا الۡمُضۡغَةَ عِظٰمًا فَكَسَوۡنَا الۡعِظٰمَ لَحۡمًا ثُمَّ اَنۡشَاۡنٰهُ خَلۡقًا اٰخَرَ ؕ فَتَبٰـرَكَ اللّٰهُ اَحۡسَنُ الۡخٰلِقِيۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: Summa khalaqnan nutfata 'alaqatan fakhalaqnal 'alaqata mudghatan fakhalaq nal mudghata 'izaaman fakasawnal 'izaama lahman summa anshaanaahu khalqan aakhar; fatabaarakal laahu ahsanul khaaliqeen
verses.saheeh: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
verses.khattab: then We developed the drop into a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then developed the clot into a lump ˹of flesh˺, then developed the lump into bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, then We brought it into being as a new creation. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators
verses.jalalayn: Then We transformed the drop [of semen] into a clot, congealed blood. Then We transformed the clot into a [little] lump of flesh (mudgha), a piece of flesh, about the size of what one would be able to chew (mā yumdagh). Then We transformed the lump of flesh into bones. Then We clothed the bones with flesh (a variant reading in both instances [instead of the plurals ‘izāman and al-‘izāma, ‘the bones’] is [singular] ‘azman [and ‘al-‘azma], ‘the bone’; and in all three instances above khalaqnā, means ‘We made it become’ [as opposed to ‘We created’]). Then We produced him as [yet] another creature, by breathing into him [Our] Spirit. So blessed be God, the best of creators!, that is, [the best of] determiners (the specificier noun for ahsana, ‘the best’, has been omitted because it is obvious: khalqan, ‘in terms of creation’).
verses.romanUrdu: Phir us boondh ko lothday ki shakal di, phir lothday ko boti bana diya, phir boti ki haddiyan (bones) banayin, phir haddiyon par gosht chadhaya. Phir usey ek dusri hi makhlooq bana khada kiya. Pas bada hi ba-barakat hai Allah, sab karigaron se accha kaarigar(creator)

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمۡ بَعۡدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: Summa innakum ba'da zaalika la maaiyitoon
verses.saheeh: Then indeed, after that you are to die.
verses.khattab: After that you will surely die
verses.jalalayn: Then indeed after that you die.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir iske baad tumko zaroor marna hai

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ تُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Summa innakum Yawmal Qiyaamati tub'asoon
verses.saheeh: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
verses.khattab: then on the Day of Judgment you will be resurrected
verses.jalalayn: Then on the Day of Resurrection you shall surely be raised, for reckoning and requital.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir qayamat ke roz yaqeenan tum uthaye jaogey

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَٰفِلِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعَ طَرَآٮِٕقَ ۖ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الۡخَـلۡقِ غٰفِلِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad khalaqnaa fawqakum sab'a taraaa'iqa wa maa kunnaa 'anil khalqi ghaafileen
verses.saheeh: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
verses.khattab: And indeed, We created above you seven levels ˹of heaven˺. We are never unmindful of ˹Our˺ creation
verses.jalalayn: And verily We created above you seven paths, that is, [seven] heavens (tarā’iq is the plural of tarīqa [so called] because they are the paths used by the angels) and of creation, that lies beneath these [paths], We are never unmindful, lest these should fall upon them and destroy them. Nay, but We hold them back, as [stated] in the verse: And He holds back the heaven lest it should fall upon the earth [Q. 22:65].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumhare upar humne saat (seven) raastey banaye, takhleeq ke kaam se hum kuch na-balad na thay (We are never unmindful of (our) Creation

verses.uthmani: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَسْكَنَّٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَاَسۡكَنّٰهُ فِى الۡاَرۡضِ ۖ وَاِنَّا عَلٰى ذَهَابٍۢ بِهٖ لَقٰدِرُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Wa anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am biqadarin fa-askannaahu fil ardi wa innaa 'alaa zahaabim bihee laqaa diroon
verses.saheeh: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
verses.khattab: We send down rain from the sky in perfect measure, causing it to soak into the earth. And We are surely able to take it away
verses.jalalayn: And We sent down water out of the heaven in measure, that suffices them, and We lodged it within the earth; and We are indeed able to take it away, so that they die of thirst together with their livestock.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur aasmaan se humne theek hisaab ke mutabiq ek khaas miqdar mein pani utara aur usko zameen mein thehara diya. Hum usey jis tarah chahein gayab kar sakte hain

wbw.translation: then We cause it to settle

verses.uthmani: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاَنۡشَاۡنَا لَـكُمۡ بِهٖ جَنّٰتٍ مِّنۡ نَّخِيۡلٍ وَّ اَعۡنَابٍ ۘ لَـكُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيۡرَةٌ وَّمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Fa anshaanaa lakum bihee Jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naab; lakum feehaa fawaakihu kaseeratunw wa minhaa taakuloon
verses.saheeh: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
verses.khattab: With it We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are abundant fruits, and from which you may eat
verses.jalalayn: Then We produced for you therewith gardens of date palms and vines — these being the most common fruits of the Arabs — wherein is abundant fruit for you, and whereof you eat, in summer and winter.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir is pani ke zariye se humne tumhare liye khajoor aur angoor ke baagh paida kardiye, tumhare liye in baaghon mein bahut se lazeez phal hain aur unsey tum rozi haasil karte ho

verses.uthmani: وَشَجَرَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍۢ لِّلْءَاكِلِينَ
verses.indopak: وَشَجَرَةً تَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ طُوۡرِ سَيۡنَآءَ تَنۡۢبُتُ بِالدُّهۡنِ وَصِبۡغٍ لِّلۡاٰكِلِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa shajaratan takhruju min Toori Sainaaa'a tambutu bidduhni wa sibghil lil aakileen
verses.saheeh: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.
verses.khattab: as well as ˹olive˺ trees which grow at Mount Sinai, providing oil and a condiment to eat
verses.jalalayn: And, We produced, a tree that grows on Mount of Sinai (read Sīnā’ or Saynā’, indeclinable as it is a proper noun with the feminine ending denoting a location) that produces (read either as tunbitu from the fourth form [anbata], or as tanbutu from the trilateral form [nabata]) oil (bi’l-duhni: in the case of the former [reading of tunbitu] the bā’ [bi-] here would be extra, whereas in the case of the second [reading of tanbutu], it would be [a preposition needed] for the transitive) — and this [tree] is the olive tree, and seasoning for those who eat (wa-sibghin li’l-ākilīna, a supplement to bi’l-duhni, ‘oil’, [that is to say] it is [like] a dye that colours a morsel dipped in it) — and this [seasoning] is the [olive] oil.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur woh darakht bhi humne paida kiya jo Tur-e-seena (mount sinai) se nikalta hai, teil (oil) bhi liye huey ugta hai aur khane walon ke liye saalan bhi

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَ اِنَّ لَـكُمۡ فِى الۡاَنۡعَامِ لَعِبۡرَةً ؕ نُسۡقِيۡكُمۡ مِّمَّا فِىۡ بُطُوۡنِهَا وَلَـكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيۡرَةٌ وَّمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wa inna lakum fil an'aami la'ibrah; nusqeekum mimmaa fee butoonihaa wa lakum feehaa manaafi'u kaseeratunw wa minhaa taakuloon
verses.saheeh: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
verses.khattab: And there is certainly a lesson for you in cattle, from whose bellies We give you ˹milk˺ to drink, and in them are many other benefits for you, and from them you may eat
verses.jalalayn: And surely in the cattle, that is, [in] camels, cows and sheep, there is for you a lesson, an admonition for you to heed. We give you to drink (read nasqīkum or nusqīkum) of what is in their bellies, [of] milk, and you have many uses in them, such as [the extraction of] wool, fur and hairs and other [uses], and you eat of them.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke tumhare liye maweshiyon mein bhi ek sabaq hai unke paithon (bellies) mein jo kuch hai usi mein se ek cheez hum tumhein pilatey hain, aur tumhare liye unmein bahut se dusre faiyde bhi hain

verses.uthmani: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَى الۡـفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa 'alaihaa wa'alal fulki tuhmaloon
verses.saheeh: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
verses.khattab: And you are carried upon ˹some of˺ them and upon ships
verses.jalalayn: And on them, the camels, and on ships you are carried.
verses.romanUrdu: Unko tum khate ho aur unpar aur kashtiyon par sawaar bhi kiye jatey ho

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰى قَوۡمِهٖ فَقَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗ ؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee faqaala yaa qawmi'budul laaha maa lakum min ilahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon
verses.saheeh: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
verses.khattab: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people. He declared, “O my people! Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
verses.jalalayn: And verily We sent Noah to his people, and he said, ‘O my people, worship God, obey God and affirm His Oneness. You have no [other] god besides Him (ghayruhu is the subject of mā, ‘no’; the preceding [min ilāhin, ‘god’] is the predicate, the min being extra). Will you not then fear?’ His punishment in worshipping [gods] other than Him?
verses.romanUrdu: Humne Nooh ko uski qaum ki taraf bheja, usne kaha “ aey meri qaum ke logon, Allah ki bandagi karo, uske siwa tumhare liye koi aur mabood nahin hai, kya tum darte nahin ho?”

verses.uthmani: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.indopak: فَقَالَ الۡمَلَؤُا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ مَا هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ ۙ يُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يَّـتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ؕ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَاَنۡزَلَ مَلٰٓٮِٕكَةً ۖ ۚ مَّا سَمِعۡنَا بِهٰذَا فِىۡۤ اٰبَآٮِٕنَا الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Faqaalal mala'ul lazeena kafaroo min qawmihee maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yureedu ai yatafaddala 'alaikum wa law shaaa'al laahu la anzala malaaa'ikatam maa sami'naa bihaazaa feee aabaaa'inal awwaleen
verses.saheeh: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
verses.khattab: But the disbelieving chiefs of his people said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you, who wants to be superior to you. Had Allah willed, He could have easily sent down angels ˹instead˺. We have never heard of this in ˹the history of˺ our forefathers
verses.jalalayn: But the council of his people, who disbelieved, said, to their followers, ‘This is just a human being like you who desires to gain superiority, to have the honour, over you, by acquiring followers, you being [his] followers. And had God willed, that none other than Him be worshipped, He would have sent down angels, with that [Message], and not [assigned] a human being [for it]. We never heard of such, an affirmation of God’s Oneness as that which Noah summons [us], among our forefathers, [among] past communities.
verses.romanUrdu: Uski qaum ke jin sardaaron ne maanne se inkar kiya woh kehne lagey ke “yeh shaks kuch nahin hai magar ek bashar(Insaan) tum hi jaisa. Iski garz yeh hai ke tumpar bartari (superiority) haasil karey. Allah ko agar bhejna hota to farishtey bhejta.Yeh baat to humne kabhi apne baap dada ke waqton mein suni hi nahin ( ke bashar Rasool bankar aaye)

verses.uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.indopak: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوۡا بِهٖ حَتّٰى حِيۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: In huwa illaa rajulum bihee jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihee hattan heen
verses.saheeh: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
verses.khattab: He is simply insane, so bear with him for a while.”
verses.jalalayn: He, Noah, is just a man possessed by madness, a case of dementia. So bear with him for a while’, until he dies.
verses.romanUrdu: Kuch nahin , bas is aadmi ko zara junoon lahaq(possessed) ho gaya hai, kuch muddat aur dekhlo [ ( shayad ifaqa ho jaaye)( may be he is cured)]”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
verses.indopak: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرۡنِىۡ بِمَا كَذَّبُوۡنِ
verses.transliteration: Qaala Rabbin surnee bimaa kazzaboon
verses.saheeh: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
verses.khattab: Noah prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”
verses.jalalayn: He, Noah, said, ‘My Lord, help me, against them, because they deny me’, because of their denial of me, by destroying them. God, exalted be He, says, responding to his supplication:
verses.romanUrdu: Nooh ne kaha “parwardigar, in logon ne jo meri takzeeb ki hai ispar ab tu hi meri nusrat farma.”

verses.uthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاَوۡحَيۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡهِ اَنِ اصۡنَعِ الۡفُلۡكَ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا وَ وَحۡيِنَا فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّـنُّوۡرُ ۙ فَاسۡلُكۡ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلٍّ زَوۡجَيۡنِ اثۡنَيۡنِ وَاَهۡلَكَ اِلَّا مَنۡ سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ الۡقَوۡلُ مِنۡهُمۡ ۚ وَلَا تُخَاطِبۡنِىۡ فِى الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا ۚ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّغۡرَقُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Fa awhainaaa ilaihi anis na'il fulka bi a'yuninaa wa wahyinaa fa izaa jaaa'a amrunaa wa faarat tannooru fasluk feehaa min kullin zawjainis naini wa ahlaka illaa man sabaqa 'alaihil qawlu minhum wa laa tukhaat ibnee fil lazeena zalamooo innaahum mughraqoon
verses.saheeh: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
verses.khattab: So We inspired him: “Build the Ark under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes and directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts ˹with water˺, take on board a pair from every species along with your family—except those against whom the decree ˹to drown˺ has already been passed. And do not plead with Me for those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”
verses.jalalayn: So We revealed to him [saying], ‘Build the Ark, the ship, under Our watch, under Our observation and protection, and [by] Our revelation, Our command. Then, when Our command comes, that they be destroyed, and the oven, of the baker, gushes, with water — and this was Noah’s sign — bring into it, admit into the ship, of every kind [of animal] two mates, a male and a female, that is, [two] of every species thereof (ithnayn is an object; min, ‘of’, is semantically connected to usluk, ‘bring into [it]’). According to the story God, exalted be He, gathered all the beasts of prey and the birds and other [animals] for Noah. As he [Noah] pushed forth his hands into each species, his right hand would fall upon a male and the left upon a female, whereafter he would take them on board the ship (a variant reading [for min kuli, ‘of every’] is min kullin, ‘of every [kind]’, in which case zawjayni, ‘[two] mates’, becomes a direct object, with ithnayn, ‘two’, [being repeated] for emphasis thereof); together with your family — his wife [?] and children — except for those against whom the Word has already gone forth, that they be destroyed, namely, his wife and his son Canaan (Kan‘ān), unlike Shem (Sām), Ham (Hām) and Japheth (Yāfith) whom, together with their three wives, he carried on board. In sūrat Hūd [the following is mentioned where Noah is told who he should carry in the ship]: ‘… and those who believe.’ And none believed with him except a few [Q. 11:40]. It is said that these were six men and their wives. Moreover it is said that all those who were on the ship numbered seventy eight, half of them were men and half were women. And do not plead with Me concerning those who have done wrong, those who have disbelieved, that I should refrain from destroying them. They shall indeed be drowned.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne uspar wahee ki ke “hamari nigrani mein aur hamari wahee ke mutabiq kashti (ark) tayyar kar. Phir jab hamara hukum aa jaye aur tannur ubal paday to har qisam ke jaanwaron mein se ek ek joda lekar usmein sawaar ho ja, aur apne ehal o ayaal ko bhi saath le, siwai unke jinke khilaf pehle faisla ho chuka hai, aur zaalimon ke maamle mein mujhse kuch na kehna, yeh ab garq (doob/ drown) honay waley hain

verses.uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاِذَا اسۡتَوَيۡتَ اَنۡتَ وَمَنۡ مَّعَكَ عَلَى الۡـفُلۡكِ فَقُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىۡ نَجّٰٮنَا مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Fa izas tawaita ata wa mam ma'aka 'alal fulki faqulil hamdu lillaahil lazee najjaanaa minal qawmiz zalimeen
verses.saheeh: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
verses.khattab: Then when you and those with you have settled in the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”
verses.jalalayn: And when you have settled, [when] you are balanced, in the Ark together with those with you, say, “Praise be to God Who has delivered us from the wrongdoing folk”, [from] the disbelievers and the destruction that came upon them.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir jab tu apne saathiyon sameth kashti par sawar ho jaye to keh, shukar hai us khuda ka jisne humein zaalim logon se nijaat di

verses.uthmani: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًۭا مُّبَارَكًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
verses.indopak: وَقُلْ رَّبِّ اَنۡزِلۡنِىۡ مُنۡزَلًا مُّبٰـرَكًا وَّاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الۡمُنۡزِلِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa qur Rabbi anzilnee munzalam mubaarakanw wa Anta khairul munzileen
verses.saheeh: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "
verses.khattab: And pray, “My Lord! Allow me a blessed landing, for You are the best accommodator.”
verses.jalalayn: And say, upon disembarking from the ship: “My Lord, cause me to land with a landing (read munzalan as the verbal noun as well as the noun of place [for ‘landing’]; or manzilan as [meaning] the site of the landing) blessed, being that landing or place, for You are the best of all who bring to land” ’, that which has been mentioned.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur keh, parwardigar, mujhko barakat wali jagah utaar aur tu behtareen jagah dene wala hai.”

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰ لِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ وَّاِنۡ كُنَّا لَمُبۡتَلِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaatinw wa in kunnaa lamubtaleen
verses.saheeh: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
verses.khattab: Surely in this are lessons. And We ˹always˺ put ˹people˺ to the test
verses.jalalayn: Surely in that, mentioned matter of Noah, the ship and the destruction of the disbelievers, there are signs, indicators of God’s power, exalted be He, and indeed (wa-in, in has been softened in place of the hardened form, its subject being the pronoun of the matter) We were putting to the test, [indeed We were] trying the people of Noah by sending him [as God’s messenger] to them and [by] his admonitions [to them].
verses.romanUrdu: Is qissey mein badi nishaniyan hain aur aazmaish to hum karke hi rehte hain

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ اَنۡشَاۡنَا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قَرۡنًا اٰخَرِيۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Summaa anshaana mim ba'dihim qarnan aakhareen
verses.saheeh: Then We produced after them a generation of others.
verses.khattab: Then We raised another generation after them
verses.jalalayn: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation, [another] people, namely, and these were [the people of] ‘Ād.
verses.romanUrdu: Inke baad humne ek dusre daur ki qaum uthayi

verses.uthmani: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيۡهِمۡ رَسُوۡلًا مِّنۡهُمۡ اَنِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗ ؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Fa arsalnaa feehim Rasoolam minhum ani'budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon
verses.saheeh: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
verses.khattab: and sent to them a messenger from among themselves, ˹declaring,˺ “Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
verses.jalalayn: And We sent among them a messenger of their own, namely, Hūd, saying, ‘Worship God! You have no other god besides Him. Will you not then be wary?’, of His punishment and become believers?
verses.romanUrdu: Phir un mein khud unhi ki qaum ka ek Rasool bheja ( jisne unhein dawat di) ke Allah ki bandagi karo, tumhare liye uske siwa koi aur maabood nahin hai, kya tum darte nahin ho

verses.uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
verses.indopak: وَقَالَ الۡمَلَاُ مِنۡ قَوۡمِهِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَكَذَّبُوۡا بِلِقَآءِ الۡاٰخِرَةِ وَاَتۡرَفۡنٰهُمۡ فِى الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا ۙ مَا هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ ۙ يَاۡكُلُ مِمَّا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَيَشۡرَبُ مِمَّا تَشۡرَبُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wa qaalal mala-u min qawmihil lazeena kafaroo wa kazzaboo bi liqaaa'il Aakhirati wa atrafnaahum fil hayaatid dunyaa maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yaakulu mimmaa taakuloona minhu wa yashrabu mimmaa tashraboon
verses.saheeh: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
verses.khattab: But the chiefs of his people—who disbelieved, denied the meeting ˹with Allah˺ in the Hereafter, and were spoiled by the worldly luxuries We had provided for them—said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you. He eats what you eat, and drinks what you drink
verses.jalalayn: The council of his people, who disbelieved and denied the encounter of the Hereafter, [they denied] that they will end up thereat, and whom We had given affluence, whom We had provided with comforts, in the life of this world, said: ‘This is only a human being like you: he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.
verses.romanUrdu: Uski qaum ke jin sardaron ne maanne se inkar kiya aur aakhirat ki peshi ko jhutlaya, jinko humne duniya ki zindagi mein aasuda kar rakkha tha, woh kehne lagey “ye shaks kuch nahin hai magar ek bashar tum hi jaisa, jo kuch tum khate ho wahi yeh khata hai aur jo kuch tum peete ho wahi yeh peeta hai

wbw.translation: while We had given them luxury

verses.uthmani: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًۭا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَٮِٕنۡ اَطَعۡتُمۡ بَشَرًا مِّثۡلَـكُمۡ اِنَّكُمۡ اِذًا لَّخٰسِرُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wa la'in at'atum basharam mislakum innakum izal lakhaasiroon
verses.saheeh: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
verses.khattab: And if you ˹ever˺ obey a human like yourselves, then you would certainly be losers
verses.jalalayn: And, by God, if you obey a human being like yourselves (this [clause] contains both an oath and a conditional; the response belongs to the former [the oath], which [at the same time] suffices in place of a response for the latter [the conditional]) you will surely then, that is, should you obey them, be losers, you will have been duped.
verses.romanUrdu: Ab agar tumne apne hi jaise ek bashar ki itaat qabool karli to tum ghatay hi mein rahey

verses.uthmani: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
verses.indopak: اَيَعِدُكُمۡ اَنَّكُمۡ اِذَا مِتُّمۡ وَكُنۡتُمۡ تُرَابًا وَّعِظَامًا اَنَّكُمۡ مُّخۡرَجُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: A-Ya'idukum annakum izaa mittum wa kuntum turaabanw wa izaaman annakum mukhrajoon
verses.saheeh: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
verses.khattab: Does he promise you that once you are dead and reduced to dust and bones, you will be brought forth ˹alive˺
verses.jalalayn: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones, you shall be brought forth? (mukhrajūna, this is the predicate of the first annakum, ‘that … you’; the second annakum [simply] reiterates it because of the long separation [between the subject and its predicate]).
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh tumhein ittila deta hai ke jab tum mar kar mitti ho jaogey aur haddiyon ka panjar reh jaogey us waqt tum (qabaron se) nikale jaogey

verses.uthmani: هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.indopak: هَيۡهَاتَ هَيۡهَاتَ لِمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Haihaata haihaata limaa too'adoon
verses.saheeh: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
verses.khattab: Impossible, simply impossible is what you are promised
verses.jalalayn: Far-fetched, far-fetched (hayhāt is a noun of action in the past tense, functioning as a verbal noun, meaning ba‘uda ba‘uda, ‘far from it, far from it!’) is what you are promised!, in the way of being brought forth from the graves (li-mā: the lām is extra, for explication).
verses.romanUrdu: Baeed (far/Impossible), bilkul baeed(Impossible) hai yeh wada jo tumse kiya jaa raha hai

verses.uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنۡ هِىَ اِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنۡيَا نَمُوۡتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوۡثِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: In hiya illaa hayaatunad dunyaa namootu wa nahyaa wa maa nahnu bimab'ooseen
verses.saheeh: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
verses.khattab: There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die, others are born, and none will be resurrected
verses.jalalayn: There is nothing, that is, there is no life, but our life in this world: we die, and we live, [again only] through the lives of our offspring, and we shall not be raised [again].
verses.romanUrdu: Zindagi kuch nahin hai magar bas yahi duniya ki zindagi. Yahin humko marna aur jeena hai aur hum hargiz uthaye janey waley nahin hain

verses.uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلُ اۨفۡتَـرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا وَّمَا نَحۡنُ لَهٗ بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: In huwa illaa rajulunif taraa 'alal laahi kazibanw wa maa nahnuu lahoo bimu'mineen
verses.saheeh: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him."
verses.khattab: He is no more than a man who has fabricated a lie about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”
verses.jalalayn: He is, the Messenger is, just a man who has invented a lie against God, and we will not believe in him’, we will [not] accept the truth of resurrection after death.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh shaks khuda ke naam par mehaz jhoot ghadh raha hai aur hum kabhi iske maanne waley nahin hain.”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
verses.indopak: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرۡنِىۡ بِمَا كَذَّبُوۡنِ
verses.transliteration: Qaala Rabbin surnee bimaa kazzaboon
verses.saheeh: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
verses.khattab: The messenger prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”
verses.jalalayn: He said, ‘My Lord, help me because they have denied me’.
verses.romanUrdu: Rasool ne kaha “parwardigar , in logon ne jo meri takzeeb ki hai, ispar ab tu hi meri nusrat farma”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍۢ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيۡلٍ لَّيُصۡبِحُنَّ نٰدِمِيۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Qaala 'ammaa qaleelil la yusbihunna naadimeen
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
verses.khattab: Allah responded, “Soon they will be truly regretful.”
verses.jalalayn: He said, ‘In a little while, of time (‘ammā: the mā is extra), they will become remorseful’, about their disbelief and their denial.
verses.romanUrdu: Jawab mein irshad hua “qareeb hai woh waqt jab yeh apne kiye par pachtayenge”

verses.uthmani: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءًۭ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصَّيۡحَةُ بِالۡحَـقِّ فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ غُثَآءً ۚ فَبُعۡدًا لِّـلۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Fa akhazat humus saihatu bilhaqqi faja'alnaahum ghusaaa'aa; fabu;dal lilqaw miz zaalimeen
verses.saheeh: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
verses.khattab: Then the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them with justice, and We reduced them to rubble. So away with the wrongdoing people
verses.jalalayn: So the Cry, the Cry of chastisement and destruction, seized them rightfully, and they died, and We made them as husks (ghuthā’ is desiccated vegetation, in other words, We transformed them into similarly desiccated [worthless] things). So a far removal, from mercy, for the evildoing folk, the denying [folk].
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar theek theek haqq ke mutabiq ek hungama e azeem ne unko aa liya aur humne inko kachra bana kar phenk diya. Door ho zaalim qaum

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ اَنۡشَاۡنَا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قُرُوۡنًا اٰخَرِيۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: Summa anshaanaa mim ba'dihim quroonan aakhareen
verses.saheeh: Then We produced after them other generations.
verses.khattab: Then We raised other generations after them
verses.jalalayn: Then, after them, We brought forth other generations, [other] peoples.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir humne unke baad dusri qaumein uthayi

verses.uthmani: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verses.indopak: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـاۡخِرُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wa maa yastaakhiroon
verses.saheeh: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
verses.khattab: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it
verses.jalalayn: No community can precede its term, by dying before it, nor be deferred, beyond it (the person [in the second verb yasta’khirūna, ‘be deferred’] is masculine, having been feminine [in the first verb tasbiqu, ‘precede’] because this [masculine plural] takes into account the [plural masculine] content [of the term ‘community’]).
verses.romanUrdu: Koi qaum na apne waqt se pehle khatam hui aur na uske baad thehar saki

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةًۭ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًۭا وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ اَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتۡـرَا ؕ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ اُمَّةً رَّسُوۡلُهَا كَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَتۡبَـعۡنَا بَعۡـضَهُمۡ بَعۡـضًا وَّجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ اَحَادِيۡثَ ۚ فَبُـعۡدًا لِّـقَوۡمٍ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Summa arsalnaa Rusulanaa tatraa kulla maa jaaa'a ummatar Rasooluhaa kazzabooh; fa atba'naa ba'dahum ba'danw wa ja'alnaahum ahaadees; fabu'dal liqawmil laa yu'minoon
verses.saheeh: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.
verses.khattab: Then We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to his people, they denied him. So We destroyed them, one after the other, reducing them to ˹cautionary˺ tales. So away with the people who refuse to believe
verses.jalalayn: Then sent We Our messengers successively (read tatran or tatrā: one following the other, with a long interval between every two). Whenever there came to a community (jā’a ummatan: read pronouncing both hamzas, or without pronouncing the second one between it and the wāw [vowel]) its messenger they denied him; so We made them follow one another, to destruction, and We turned them into folktales. So away with a people who do not believe!
verses.romanUrdu: Phir humne pai dar pai apne Rasool bheje. Jis qaum ke paas bhi uska Rasool aaya, usne usey jhutlaya, aur hum ek ke baad ek qaum ko halaak karte chale gaye hatta ke unko bas afsana hi bana kar choda, phitkar un logon par jo iman nahin laatey

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰى وَاَخَاهُ هٰرُوۡنَ ۙ بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Summa arsalnaa Moosaa wa akhaahu Haaroona bi Aayaatinaa wa sultaanim mubeen
verses.saheeh: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
verses.khattab: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and compelling proof
verses.jalalayn: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a manifest warrant, a clear proof, namely, the hand, the staff and other signs,
verses.romanUrdu: Phir humne Moosa aur uske bhai Haroon ko apni nishaniyon aur khuli sanad ke saath Firoun aur uske ayaan sultanat ki taraf bheja

verses.uthmani: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
verses.indopak: اِلٰى فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۟ٮِٕهٖ فَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا عٰلِيۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Ilaa Fir'awna wa mala'ihee fastakbaroo wa kaanoo qawman 'aaleem
verses.saheeh: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
verses.khattab: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a tyrannical people
verses.jalalayn: to Pharaoh and his council; but they disdained, to believing in them and in God, and they were a tyrannical folk, subjugating the Children of Israel through oppression.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar unhon ne takabbur (arrogance) kiya aur badi dunki li

verses.uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ
verses.indopak: فَقَالُـوۡۤا اَنُؤۡمِنُ لِبَشَرَيۡنِ مِثۡلِنَا وَقَوۡمُهُمَا لَـنَا عٰبِدُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Faqaaloo annu'minu libasharaini mislinaa wa qawmuhumaa lanaa 'aabidoon
verses.saheeh: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
verses.khattab: They argued, “Will we believe in two humans, like ourselves, whose people are slaves to us?”
verses.jalalayn: And they said, ‘Shall we believe two humans like ourselves, while their people are servile to us?’, obedient and submissive.
verses.romanUrdu: Kehne lage “Kya hum apne hi jaise do aadmiyon par iman le aayein? Aur aadmi bhi woh jinki qaum hamari bandi (ghulam) hai”

verses.uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
verses.indopak: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُمَا فَكَانُوۡا مِنَ الۡمُهۡلَـكِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Fakazzaboohumaa fakaanoo minal mmuhlakeen
verses.saheeh: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
verses.khattab: So they rejected them both, and ˹so˺ were among those destroyed
verses.jalalayn: So they denied them [both] and became of those who were destroyed.
verses.romanUrdu: Pas unhon ne dono ko jhutla diya aur halaak honay walon mein jaa miley

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَى الۡـكِتٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba la'allahum yahtadoon
verses.saheeh: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.
verses.khattab: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so perhaps his people would be ˹rightly˺ guided
verses.jalalayn: And verily We gave Moses the Scripture, the Torah, that perhaps they, his people, the Children of Israel, might be guided, thereby from error — he [Moses] was given it [the Scripture] after the destruction of Pharaoh and his folk all at once.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Moosa ko humne kitaab ata farmayi taa-ke log ussey rehnumayi haasil karein

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verses.indopak: وَجَعَلۡنَا ابۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ وَاُمَّهٗۤ اٰيَةً وَّاٰوَيۡنٰهُمَاۤ اِلٰى رَبۡوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَّمَعِيۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa ja'alnab na Maryama wa ummahooo aayatannw wa aawainaahumaaa ilaa rabwatin zaati qaraarinw wa ma'een
verses.saheeh: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
verses.khattab: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and gave them refuge on high ground—a ˹suitable˺ place for rest with flowing water
verses.jalalayn: And We made the son of Mary, Jesus, and his mother a sign — He did not say ‘two signs’ because the same sign is in both of them: his being born without [his mother’s having] a male spouse. And We gave them refuge on a height (rabwa), a highland — in this case [either] the Holy House [of Jerusalem], Damascus or Palestine, all of which are [alternative] opinions — level (dhāt qarār), an flat [high-] land on which its inhabitants are able to settle (yastaqirru), and watered by springs, running water, over ground, which the eyes can see.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Ibne Maryam aur uski maa ko humne ek nishani banaya aur unko ek sateh murtafa (shelter on a plateau) par rakkha jo itminaan ki jagah thi aur chashme usmein jaari thay

verses.uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.indopak: يٰۤـاَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوۡا مِنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَاعۡمَلُوْا صَالِحًـا ؕ اِنِّىۡ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ عَلِيۡمٌ ؕ
verses.transliteration: Yaaa aiyuhar Rusulu kuloo minat taiyibaati wa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona 'Aleem
verses.saheeh: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.
verses.khattab: O messengers! Eat from what is good and lawful, and act righteously. Indeed, I fully know what you do
verses.jalalayn: ‘O messengers, eat of the good things, the lawful things, and perform righteous acts, such as obligatory and supererogatory [rituals]. Surely I know what you do, and will requite you for it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aey paigambaron, khao paak cheezein aur amal karo saleh, tum jo kuch bhi karte ho, main usko khoob jaanta hoon

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّ هٰذِهٖۤ اُمَّتُكُمۡ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّاَنَا رَبُّكُمۡ فَاتَّقُوۡنِ
verses.transliteration: Wa inna haaziheee ummatukum ummatanw waahidatanw wa Ana Rabbukum fattaqoon
verses.saheeh: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
verses.khattab: Surely this religion of yours is ˹only˺ one, and I am your Lord, so fear Me ˹alone˺
verses.jalalayn: And know, that this, creed of Islam, is your community, your religion, O you being addressed, that is, you must adhere to it as, one community — a necessary state [of affairs] (a variant reading [for anna, ‘that’] has the softened form [in]; a variant has inna, ‘truly’, indicating the beginning of [an independent] new sentence) and I am your Lord, so fear Me’, so be fearful of Me.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh tumhari yeh ummat ek hi ummat hai aur main tumhara Rubb hoon, pas mujhi se tum daro

verses.uthmani: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
verses.indopak: فَتَقَطَّعُوۡۤا اَمۡرَهُمۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ زُبُرًا ؕ كُلُّ حِزۡبٍۢ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Fataqatta'ooo amrahum bainahum zuburaa; kullu hizbim bimaa ladaihim farihoon
verses.saheeh: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
verses.khattab: Yet the people have divided it into different sects, each rejoicing in what they have
verses.jalalayn: But they, the followers, split into sects regarding their affair, their religion (zuburan, ‘sects’, is a circumstantial qualifier of the subject of the verb taqatta‘ū, ‘they split’), in other words, [they became] opposing parties, the likes of the Jews and the Christians and others, each party rejoicing in, exultant with, what they had, that is, with the religion they had.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar baad mein logon ne apne deen (religion) ko aapas mein tukde tukde karliya, har giroh ke paas jo kuch hai usi mein woh magan hai

verses.uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.indopak: فَذَرۡهُمۡ فِىۡ غَمۡرَتِهِمۡ حَتّٰى حِيۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: Fazarhum fee ghamratihim hattaa heen
verses.saheeh: So leave them in their confusion for a time.
verses.khattab: So leave them ˹O Prophet˺ in their heedlessness for a while
verses.jalalayn: So leave them, the disbelievers of Mecca, in their error, their misguidance, for a while, until they die.
verses.romanUrdu: Accha, to chodo inhein, doobey rahein apni gaflat mein ek waqt e khaas tak

verses.uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
verses.indopak: اَيَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمۡ بِهٖ مِنۡ مَّالٍ وَّبَنِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: A-yahsaboona annnamaa numiduhum bihee mimmaalinw wa baneen
verses.saheeh: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
verses.khattab: Do they think, since We provide them with wealth and children
verses.jalalayn: Do they suppose that in the wealth and children with which We provide them, in the life of this world,
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh samajhte hain ke hum jo inhein maal o aulad se madad diye jaa rahey hain

verses.uthmani: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.indopak: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمۡ فِى الۡخَيۡـرٰتِ ؕ بَلْ لَّا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Nusaari'u lahum fil khairaat; bal laa yash'uroon
verses.saheeh: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.
verses.khattab: that We hasten to ˹honour˺ them ˹with˺ all kinds of good? No! They are not aware
verses.jalalayn: We are hastening to [provide] them with good things? No. Rather, they are not aware, that this is a way of gradually drawing them [into their punishment].
verses.romanUrdu: To goya inhein bhalaiyan dene mein sargarm hain? Nahin, asal maamle ka inhein shaour nahin hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ رَبِّهِمۡ مُّشۡفِقُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Innal lazeena hum min khashyati Rabbihim mushfiqoon
verses.saheeh: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
verses.khattab: Surely those who tremble in awe of their Lord
verses.jalalayn: Surely those who, for fear of their Lord, are apprehensive, are fearful of His chastisement,
verses.romanUrdu: Jo apne Rubb ke khauf se darey rehte hain

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wallazeena hum bi Aayaati Rabbihim yu'minoon
verses.saheeh: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
verses.khattab: and who believe in the revelations of their Lord
verses.jalalayn: and who believe in, [who] accept the truth of, the signs of their Lord — the Qur'an;
verses.romanUrdu: Jo Rubb ki aayat par iman latey hain

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ بِرَبِّهِمۡ لَا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wallazeena hum bi Rabbihim laa yushrikoon
verses.saheeh: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
verses.khattab: and who associate none with their Lord
verses.jalalayn: and who do not associate others with their Lord,
verses.romanUrdu: Jo apne Rubb ke saath kisi ko shareek nahin karte

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يُؤۡتُوۡنَ مَاۤ اٰتَوْا وَّ قُلُوۡبُهُمۡ وَجِلَةٌ اَنَّهُمۡ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمۡ رٰجِعُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wallazeena yu'toona maaa aataw wa quloobuhum wajilatun annahum ilaa Rabbihim raaji'oon
verses.saheeh: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -
verses.khattab: and who do whatever ˹good˺ they do with their hearts fearful, ˹knowing˺ that they will return to their Lord—
verses.jalalayn: and who give what they give, of voluntary alms and righteous deeds, while their hearts tremble [with awe], fearful lest it not be accepted from them, because (the particle lām, ‘for’, is taken as implied before annahum, ‘that they’) they are going to return to their Lord —
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jinka haal yeh hai ke detay hain jo kuch bhi detay hain aur dil unke is khayal se kaampte rehte hain ke humein apne Rubb ki taraf palatna hai

verses.uthmani: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ
verses.indopak: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ يُسَارِعُوۡنَ فِىۡ الۡخَيۡـرٰتِ وَهُمۡ لَهَا سٰبِقُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Ulaaa'ika yusaari'oona fil khairaati wa hum lahaa saabiqoon
verses.saheeh: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
verses.khattab: it is they who race to do good deeds, always taking the lead
verses.jalalayn: those [are the ones who] hasten to [perform] good works, and they [are the ones who] shall come out ahead in them, according to God’s knowledge.
verses.romanUrdu: Bhalaiyon ki taraf daudne waley aur sabaqat karke unhein paa lene waley to dar-haqeeqat woh log hain

verses.uthmani: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَٰبٌۭ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَا نُـكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا اِلَّا وُسۡعَهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا كِتٰبٌ يَّـنۡطِقُ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa wa ladainaa kitaabuny yantiqu bilhaqqi w ahum la yuzlamoon
verses.saheeh: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
verses.khattab: We never require of any soul more than what it can afford. And with Us is a record which speaks the truth. None will be wronged
verses.jalalayn: And We do not task any soul beyond its capacity, what it can bear — thus he who is not able to pray standing, let him pray sitting down and he who is not able to fast, let him eat; and with Us is a Record that speaks the truth, regarding what it [a soul] has done — and this [Record] is the Preserved Tablet (al-lawh al-mahfūz), wherein deeds are written down; and they, namely, the souls in their acts, will not be wronged, in a single thing thereof, and so nothing is diminished of the reward for good deeds, nor is anything [extra] added to the evil deeds.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum kisi shaks ko uski maqdart (taaqat) se zyada ki takleef nahin detay aur humare paas ek kitaab hai jo (har ek ka haal) theek theek bata dene wali hai, aur logon par zulm bahr-haal nahin kiya jayega

verses.uthmani: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلٌۭ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ
verses.indopak: بَلۡ قُلُوۡبُهُمۡ فِىۡ غَمۡرَةٍ مِّنۡ هٰذَا وَلَهُمۡ اَعۡمَالٌ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ ذٰلِكَ هُمۡ لَهَا عٰمِلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratim min haazaa wa lahum a'maalum min dooni zaalika hum lahaa 'aamiloon
verses.saheeh: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,
verses.khattab: But the hearts of those ˹who disbelieve˺ are oblivious to ˹all of˺ this, and they have other ˹evil˺ deeds, opposite to this, in which they are engrossed
verses.jalalayn: Nay, but their hearts, that is, [the hearts of] the disbelievers, are in ignorance of this, Qur'an, and they have other deeds which they will perpetrate besides, the ones mentioned, against the believers, and they will therefore be chastised for them.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar yeh log is maamle se be-khabar hain aur inke aamal bhi is tareeqe se ( jiska upar zikr kiya gaya hai) mukhtalif hain. Woh apne yeh karoot kiye chale jayenge

verses.uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
verses.indopak: حَتّٰۤى اِذَاۤ اَخَذۡنَا مُتۡـرَفِيۡهِمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ اِذَا هُمۡ يَجۡـــَٔرُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: Hattaaa izaaa akhznaa mutrafeehim bil'azaabi izaa hum yaj'aroon
verses.saheeh: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help.
verses.khattab: But as soon as We seize their elite with torment, they start to cry for help
verses.jalalayn: Indeed (hattā is for inceptiveness) when We seize their affluent ones, their wealthy and their leaders, with chastisement, [with] the sword, on the day of Badr, behold! they are supplicating loudly, clamouring [in supplication]. It is [then] said to them:
verses.romanUrdu: Yahan tak ke jab hum unke ayyashon (affluent ones /aasuda haal) ko azaab mein pakad lenge to phir woh dakrana shuru kar denge (begin to bellow /cry)

verses.uthmani: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
verses.indopak: لَا تَجۡـــَٔرُوا الۡيَوۡمَ اِنَّكُمۡ مِّنَّا لَا تُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Laa taj'arul yawma innakum minnaa laa tunsaroon
verses.saheeh: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
verses.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “Do not cry for help today. Surely you will never be saved from Us
verses.jalalayn: ‘Do not supplicate [out loud] on this day! Truly you will not receive help, you will not be protected, against Us.
verses.romanUrdu: Ab bandh karo apni fariyad o fugaan, hamari taraf se ab koi madad tumhein nahin milni

verses.uthmani: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
verses.indopak: قَدۡ كَانَتۡ اٰيٰتِىۡ تُتۡلٰى عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَـكُنۡتُمۡ عَلٰٓى اَعۡقَابِكُمۡ تَـنۡكِصُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Qad kaanat Aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum 'alaaa a'qaabikum tankisoon
verses.saheeh: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels
verses.khattab: Indeed, My revelations were recited to you, but you used to back away ˹in disgust˺
verses.jalalayn: Verily My signs, in the Qur'an, used to be recited to you, but you used to take to your heels, falling back in retreat,
verses.romanUrdu: Meri aayat sunayi jati thi to tum (Rasool ki aawaz sunte hi) ultay paon bhaag nikalte thay

verses.uthmani: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرًۭا تَهْجُرُونَ
verses.indopak: مُسۡتَكۡبِرِيۡنَ ۖ بِهٖ سٰمِرًا تَهۡجُرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Mustakbireena bihee saamiran tahjuroon
verses.saheeh: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
verses.khattab: boasting of the Sacred House, and babbling ˹nonsense about the Quran˺ by night.”
verses.jalalayn: disdainful, of [embracing] faith, because of it, that is, because of the [Sacred] House or the [Meccan] Sanctuary and their being inhabitants thereof, secure, in contrast to [the situation with] all [other] peoples in their hometowns, while in [your] night sessions (sāmiran is a circumstantial qualifier,) in other words, they come together to converse at night around the [Sacred] House, you talked nonsense’ ([if read as] tahjurūna, the third form [from hajara] means [while] ‘you disregarded’ the Qur'an; [but if read] as the fourth form [tuhjirūna, from ahjara] it means [while] ‘you speak falsehood’ about the Prophet and the Qur'an).
verses.romanUrdu: Apne ghamand mein usko khatir hi mein na latey thay,apne chaoupalon (meeting places) mein unpar baatein chaant-te (ridiculed him) aur bakwas kiya karte thay

verses.uthmani: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.indopak: اَفَلَمۡ يَدَّبَّرُوا الۡقَوۡلَ اَمۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مَّا لَمۡ يَاۡتِ اٰبَآءَهُمُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Afalam yaddabbarrul qawla am jaaa'ahum maa lam yaati aabaaa'ahumul awwaleen
verses.saheeh: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
verses.khattab: Is it because they have never contemplated the Word ˹of Allah˺? Or ˹because˺ there has come to them something that did not come to their forefathers
verses.jalalayn: God, exalted be He, says: Have they not contemplated (yaddabbarū should actually be yatadabbarū, but the tā’ has been assimilated with the dāl) the discourse, namely, the Qur'an that is proof of the Prophet’s sincerity, or has there come upon them that which has not come upon their forefathers?
verses.romanUrdu: To kya in logon ne kabhi is kalaam par gaur nahin kiya? Ya woh koi aisi baat laya hai jo kabhi inke aslaaf (forefathers) ke paas na aayi thi

verses.uthmani: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ لَمۡ يَعۡرِفُوۡا رَسُوۡلَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَهٗ مُنۡكِرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Am lam ya'rifoo Rasoolahum fahum lahoo munkiroon
verses.saheeh: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
verses.khattab: Or ˹because˺ they failed to recognize their Messenger, and so they denied him
verses.jalalayn: Or is it that they do not recognise their [own] Messenger and so they reject him?
verses.romanUrdu: Ya yeh apne Rasool se kabhi ke waqif na thay ke (anjaana aadmi honay ke baais) ussey bidakte hain

verses.uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ يَـقُوۡلُوۡنَ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌ ؕ بَلۡ جَآءَهُمۡ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَاَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كٰرِهُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Am yaqooloona bihee jinnnah; bal jaaa'ahum bilhaqqi wa aksaruhum lil haqqi kaarihoon
verses.saheeh: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
verses.khattab: Or ˹because˺ they say, “He is insane?” In fact, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are resentful of the truth
verses.jalalayn: Or do they say, ‘There is a madness in him’? — this interrogative is meant as an affirmation of the truth of the Prophet’s sincerity, and [of the fact] that messengers did come to past communities, and [of the fact] that they [do indeed] recognise their Messenger to be truthful and trustworthy, and [of the fact] that there is no madness in him. Nay (bal is for transition), he has brought them the truth, namely, the Qur'an that comprises [affirmations of] the Oneness [of God] and the Laws of Islam; but most of them are averse to the truth.
verses.romanUrdu: Ya ye is baat ke qayal hain ke woh majnoon [possessed (by a jinn)] hai? Nahin, balke woh haqq laya hai aur haqq hi inki aksariyat (most) ko nagawar hai

verses.uthmani: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الۡحَـقُّ اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ وَمَنۡ فِيۡهِنَّ ؕ بَلۡ اَتَيۡنٰهُمۡ بِذِكۡرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِهِمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: Wa lawit taba'al haqqu ahwaaa'ahum lafasadatis samaawaatu wal ardu wa man feehinnn; bal atainaahum bizikrihim fahum 'an zikrihim mu'ridon
verses.saheeh: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.
verses.khattab: Had the truth followed their desires, the heavens, the earth, and all those in them would have certainly been corrupted. In fact, We have brought them ˹the means to˺ their glory, but they turn away from it
verses.jalalayn: And if the truth, namely, the Qur'an, had followed their desires, and come to them with [mention of] what they fancied in the way of God having a partner and a child, may God be exalted above such [associations], indeed the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been corrupted, they [the heavens and the earth] would have deviated from their observed order, because contradictions would ensue, as is usually the case, when there is more than one ruler. Nay, We have brought them their Remembrance, namely, the Qur'an, in which they are remembered and honoured, but they are disregardful of their [own] Remembrance.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haqq agar kahin inki khwaishaat ke peechey chalta to zameen aur aasman aur inki saari aabaadi ka nizam darham barham ho jata. Nahin, balke hum unka apna hi zikar unke paas laaye hain aur woh apne zikr se mooh moad rahey hain

verses.uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًۭا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ تَسۡــَٔـلُهُمۡ خَرۡجًا فَخَرٰجُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٌ ۖ وَّهُوَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰزِقِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharaaju Rabbika khairunw wa Huwa khairur raaziqeen
verses.saheeh: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
verses.khattab: Or ˹is it because˺ you ˹O Prophet˺ are asking them for tribute? But the reward of your Lord is best, for He is the Best Provider
verses.jalalayn: Or do you ask them for any recompense?, any remuneration, in return for the faith that you have brought them? Yet the recompense of your Lord is, His remuneration, His reward and His provision [are], better (one reading has kharjan, ‘recompense’, in both instances [sc. kharjan fa-kharju]; another has kharājan in both [sc. kharājan fa-kharāju]) and He is the best of providers, the best of givers and remunerators.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tu insey kuch maang raha hai? Tere liye tere Rubb ka diya hi behtar hai aur woh behtareen raziq hai

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّكَ لَـتَدۡعُوۡهُمۡ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa innaka latad'oohum ilaa Siraatim Mustaqeem
verses.saheeh: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
verses.khattab: And surely you are calling them to the Straight Path
verses.jalalayn: And truly you summon them to a straight path, a [straight] route, that is, the religion of Islam.
verses.romanUrdu: Tu to unko seedhey raaste ki taraf bula raha hai

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَـنٰكِبُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa innnal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil Aakhirati 'anis siraati lanaakiboon
verses.saheeh: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
verses.khattab: but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are certainly deviating from that Path
verses.jalalayn: And truly those who do not believe in the Hereafter, in resurrection, reward and punishment, deviate, swerve away, from the path, that is, the route [to salvation].
verses.romanUrdu: Magar jo log aakhirat ko nahin maante woh raah e raast se hat kar chalna chahte hain

verses.uthmani: وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّۢ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَوۡ رَحِمۡنٰهُمۡ وَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِمۡ مِّنۡ ضُرٍّ لَّـلَجُّوۡا فِىۡ طُغۡيَانِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa law rahimnaahum wa kashafnaa maa bihim min durril lalajjoo fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
verses.saheeh: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
verses.khattab: ˹Even˺ if We had mercy on them and removed their affliction, they would still persist in their transgression, wandering blindly
verses.jalalayn: And had We shown them mercy and relieved them of the harm afflicting them — the famine that befell them in Mecca for seven years — they would surely persist in their insolence, [in] their error, bewildered, hesitating.
verses.romanUrdu: Agar hum inpar reham karein aur woh takleef jis mein aaj kal yeh mubtila hain door kardein to yeh apni sarkashi mein bilkul hi behak jayenge

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدۡ اَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ فَمَا اسۡتَكَانُوۡا لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad akhaznaahum bil'azaabi famastakaanoo li Rabbihim wa maa yatadarra'oon
verses.saheeh: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
verses.khattab: And We have already seized them with torment, but they never humbled themselves to their Lord, nor did they ˹submissively˺ appeal ˹to Him˺
verses.jalalayn: And We have already seized them with chastisement, [with] hunger, yet they did not humble themselves to their Lord, nor did they devote themselves to prayer, [nor] did they seek [the pleasure of] God through supplication.
verses.romanUrdu: Inka haal to yeh hai ke humne unhein takleef mein mubtila kiya, phir bhi yeh apne Rubb ke aagey na jhuke aur na aajizi (humble)ikhtiyar karte hain

verses.uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا ذَا عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
verses.indopak: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيۡدٍ اِذَا هُمۡ فِيۡهِ مُبۡلِسُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Hattaaa izaa fatahnaa 'alaihim baaban zaa 'azaabin shadeedin izaa hum feehi mublisoon
verses.saheeh: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
verses.khattab: But as soon as We open for them a gate of severe punishment, they will be utterly desperate
verses.jalalayn: Until (hattā is for inceptiveness), when We opened on them the gate of a severe chastisement, namely, the day of Badr, slaying [them], behold! they are aghast thereat, despairing of anything good.
verses.romanUrdu: Albatta jab naubat yahan tak pahunch jayegi ke hum inpar sakht azaab ka darwaza khol denge to yakayak tum dekhoge ke us halat mein ye har khair se mayous hain

verses.uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡۤ اَنۡشَاَ لَـكُمُ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡاَبۡصَارَ وَالۡاَفۡـِٕدَةَ ؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa Huwal lazeee ansha a-lakumus sam'a wal absaara wal af'idah; qaleelam maa tashkuroon
verses.saheeh: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
verses.khattab: He is the One Who created for you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks
verses.jalalayn: And He it is Who made, created, for you hearing, meaning, ears, and eyes and hearts. Little thanks do you show (qalīlan mā: mā emphasises the paucity [of the thanks]).
verses.romanUrdu: Woh Allah hi to hai jisne tumhein sunney aur dekhne ki quwwatein di aur sochne ko dil diye , magar tum log kam hi shukarguzar hotey ho

verses.uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ ذَرَاَكُمۡ فِى الۡاَرۡضِ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa Huwal lazee zara akum fil ardi wa ilaihi tuhsharoon
verses.saheeh: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
verses.khattab: And He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered
verses.jalalayn: And He it is Who dispersed, created, you on earth, and to Him you shall be gathered, resurrected.
verses.romanUrdu: Wahi hai jisne tumhein zameen mein phaylaya, aur usi ki taraf tum sametay jaogey

verses.uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ يُحۡىٖ وَيُمِيۡتُ وَلَـهُ اخۡتِلَافُ الَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ ؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa Huwal lazee yuhyee wa yumeetu wa lahukh tilaaful laili wannahaar; afalaa ta'qiloon
verses.saheeh: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
verses.khattab: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of the day and night. Will you not then understand
verses.jalalayn: And He it is Who gives life, by breathing the Spirit into the embryo (mudgha), and brings death, and due to Him is the alternation of night and day, in darkness and brightness, [and through] increase and diminution. Will you not then comprehend?, His handiwork, exalted be He, and so reflect?
verses.romanUrdu: Wahi zindagi bakashta hai aur wahi maut deta hai, gardish e layl (raat) o nahar (din) usi ke qabze qudrat mein hai. Kya tumhari samajh mein yeh baat nahin aati

verses.uthmani: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.indopak: بَلۡ قَالُوۡا مِثۡلَ مَا قَالَ الۡاَوَّلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Bal qaaloo misla maa qaalal awwaloon
verses.saheeh: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
verses.khattab: But they ˹just˺ say what their predecessors said
verses.jalalayn: Nay, but they say the like of what the ancients said.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar yeh log wahi kuch kehte hain jo unke peshraw (forefathers) keh chuke hain

verses.uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡۤا ءَاِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَّ عِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوۡثُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Qaalooo 'a-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'a-innaa lamab 'oosoon
verses.saheeh: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
verses.khattab: They said, “Once we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected
verses.jalalayn: They, the ancients, said, ‘What, when we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then be raised? No! (the two hamzas in each of the two instances are either pronounced fully, or with the second one not pronounced, but with an alif inserted between the two [hamzas] in both [readings]).
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh kehte hain “kya jab hum marr kar mitti ho jayenge aur haddiyon ka panjar ban kar reh jayenge to humko phir zinda karke uthaya jayega

verses.uthmani: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.indopak: لَـقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا نَحۡنُ وَاٰبَآؤُنَا هٰذَا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ اِنۡ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّاۤ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Laqad wu'idnaa nahnu wa aabaaa'unaa haazaa min qablu in haazaaa illaaa asaateerul awwaleen
verses.saheeh: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
verses.khattab: We have already been promised this, as well as our forefathers earlier. This is nothing but ancient fables!”
verses.jalalayn: Already We and our fathers have been promised this, resurrection after death, before: these are nothing but the fables, the lies, of the ancients’, [mere] jokes and strange tales (asātīr, the plural of ustūra).
verses.romanUrdu: Humne bhi yeh wadey bahut sunay hain aur humse pehle hamare baap dada bhi suntey rahey hain. Yeh mehaz afasana haye pareena hain(ancient tales)”

verses.uthmani: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: قُلْ لِّمَنِ الۡاَرۡضُ وَمَنۡ فِيۡهَاۤ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Qul limanil ardu wa man feehaaa in kuntum ta'lamoon
verses.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
verses.khattab: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “To whom belong the earth and all those on it, if you ˹really˺ know?”
verses.jalalayn: Say, to them: ‘To whom does the earth and whoever is in it, of creatures, belong, if you [truly] knew?’, their Creator and Owner.
verses.romanUrdu: Insey kaho, batao agar tum jaante ho, ke yeh zameen aur iski saari aabaadi kiski hai

verses.uthmani: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.indopak: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ ؕ قُلۡ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Sa-yaqooloona lillaah; qul afalaa tazakkkaroon
verses.saheeh: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?"
verses.khattab: They will reply, “To Allah!” Say, “Why are you not then mindful?”
verses.jalalayn: They will say, ‘To God’. Say, to them: ‘Will you not then remember?’ (tadhakkarūna, the second tā’ [of tatadhakkarūna] has been assimilated with the dhāl) will you [not then] be admonished and so realise that the One Who has the power to originate creation also has the power to resurrect after death?
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh zaroor kahenge ke Allah ki, kaho phir tum hosh mein kyun nahin aatey

verses.uthmani: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.indopak: قُلۡ مَنۡ رَّبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ السَّبۡعِ وَرَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِيۡمِ
verses.transliteration: Qul mar Rabbus samaawaatis sab'i wa Rabbul 'Arshil 'Azeem
verses.saheeh: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
verses.khattab: ˹And˺ ask ˹them˺, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?”
verses.jalalayn: Say: ‘Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Great Throne?’, that is, the throne (kursī).
verses.romanUrdu: Insey pucho, saato (seven) aasmaano aur arsh-e-azeem ka maalik kaun hai

verses.uthmani: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.indopak: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ ؕ قُلۡ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Sa yaqooloona lillaah; qul afalaa tattaqoon
verses.saheeh: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"
