verses.khattab: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
verses.jalalayn: They will say, ‘God’. Say: ‘Will you not then be God-fearing?’, will you then [not] be wary of worshipping [things] other than Him?
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh zaroor kahenge Allah, kaho phir tum darte kyun nahin

verses.uthmani: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: قُلۡ مَنۡۢ بِيَدِهٖ مَلَكُوۡتُ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ وَّهُوَ يُجِيۡرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيۡهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Qul mam bi yadihee malakootu kulli shai'inw wa Huwa yujeeru wa laa yujaaru 'alaihi in kuntum ta'lamoon
verses.saheeh: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
verses.khattab: Ask ˹them also,˺ “In Whose Hands is the authority over all things, protecting ˹all˺ while none can protect against Him, if you ˹really˺ know?”
verses.jalalayn: Say: ‘In whose hand is the dominion, the possession, of all things (the [final] tā’ [in malakūt] is hyperbolic), and who protects, while from Him there is no protection, if you know?’
verses.romanUrdu: Insey kaho, batao agar tum jaante ho ke har cheez par iqtedaar kiska hai? Aur kaun hai woh jo panaah deta hai aur uske muqable mein koi panaah nahin de sakta

verses.uthmani: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
verses.indopak: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ ؕ قُلۡ فَاَنّٰى تُسۡحَرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Sa yaqooloona lillaah; qul fa annaa tus haroon
verses.saheeh: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
verses.khattab: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “How are you then so deluded?”
verses.jalalayn: They will say, ‘God.’ (a variant reading [for Allāh, ‘God’] in both instances [verses 87 and 89] has li’Llāh, ‘to God’, which is in keeping with the sense of ‘to whom belongs what has been mentioned?’). Say: ‘How then are you bewitched?’, [how then] are you duped and turned away from the truth, the worship of God alone, in other words, ‘How do you envisage [all] this to be invalid?’.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh zaroor kahenge ke yeh baat to Allah hi keliye hai. Kaho, phir kahan se tumko dhoka lagta hai

verses.uthmani: بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.indopak: بَلۡ اَتَيۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَكٰذِبُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Bal atainaahum bil haqqi wa innahum lakaaziboon
verses.saheeh: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
verses.khattab: In fact, We have brought them the truth, and they are certainly liars
verses.jalalayn: Nay, but We have brought them the truth, veracity, and they are indeed liars, in rejecting it, namely [the truth of the following]:
verses.romanUrdu: Jo amr e haqq hai woh hum inke saamne le aaye hain, aur koi shakk nahin ke yeh log jhotey hain

verses.uthmani: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍۢ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ ۚ إِذًۭا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.indopak: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ وَّلَدٍ وَّمَا كَانَ مَعَهٗ مِنۡ اِلٰهٍ اِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ اِلٰهٍۢ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلٰى بَعۡضٍ ؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Mat takhazal laahu minw waladinw wa maa kaana ma'ahoo min ilaah; izal lazahaba kullu ilaahim bimaa khalaqa wa la'alaa ba'duhum 'alaa ba'd; Subhaannal laahi 'ammaa yasifoon
verses.saheeh: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him].
verses.khattab: Allah has never had ˹any˺ offspring, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what he created, and they would have tried to dominate one another. Glorified is Allah above what they claim
verses.jalalayn: God has not taken any son, nor is there any god along with Him; for then, that is, if there were a god along with Him, each god would have taken away what he created, he would have made it exclusively his and prevented the other [god] from having any mastery over it; and some of them would surely rise up against others, in challenge, just as the kings of this world are wont to do. Glorified be God — an exaltation of Him — above what they ascribe, to Him, of what has been mentioned.
verses.romanUrdu: Allah ne kisi ko apni aulaad nahin banaya hai aur koi dusra khuda uske saath nahin hai. Agar aisa hota to har khuda apni khalq ko lekar alag ho jaata, aur phir woh ek dusre par chadh daudte.Paak hai Allah un baaton se jo yeh log banate hain

verses.uthmani: عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.indopak: عٰلِمِ الۡغَيۡبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: 'Aalimil Ghaibi wash shahhaadati fata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon
verses.saheeh: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
verses.khattab: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the seen and unseen. Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him˺
verses.jalalayn: Knower of the Unseen and the visible, what is hidden and what is observed ([if] read in the genitive [‘ālimi’l-ghaybi, ‘Knower of the Unseen’], this is an adjectival qualification; [if] in the nominative [‘ālimu’l-ghaybi, ‘the Knower of the Unseen], this would be the predicate of an implied [preceding] huwa, ‘He is’) and exalted, magnified, be He above what they associate!, with Him [of partners].
verses.romanUrdu: Khule aur chupe ka jaanne wala, woh baalatar hai us shirk se jo yeh log tajweez kar rahey hain

verses.uthmani: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
verses.indopak: قُل رَّبِّ اِمَّا تُرِيَنِّىۡ مَا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Qur Rabbi immmaa turiyannee maa yoo'adoon
verses.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Should You show me what they are threatened with
verses.jalalayn: Say: ‘My Lord! If (immā, this contains an assimilation of the conditional particle in with the extra mā) You should show me what they are promised, in the way of chastisement, that it is true, by their being slain at Badr,
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Muhammad) dua karo ke “parwardigar, jis azaab ki inko dhamki di jaa rahi hai woh agar meri maujoodgi mein tu laye

verses.uthmani: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِىۡ فِى الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Rabbi falaa taj'alnee fil qawmiz zaalimeen
verses.saheeh: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
verses.khattab: then, my Lord, do not count me among the wrongdoing people.”
verses.jalalayn: my Lord, then do no put me among the evildoing folk’, lest I be destroyed when they are destroyed.
verses.romanUrdu: To aey mere Rubb, mujhey in zaalim logon mein shamil na kijiyo”

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّا عَلٰٓى اَنۡ نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمۡ لَقٰدِرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa innaa 'alaaa an nuriyaka maa na'iduhum laqaadiroon
verses.saheeh: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them.
verses.khattab: We are indeed able to show you what We have threatened them with
verses.jalalayn: And truly We are able to show you what We promise them.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum tumhari aankhon ke saamne hi woh cheez le aane ki poori qudrat rakhte hain jiski dhamki hum unhein de rahey hain

verses.uthmani: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
verses.indopak: اِدۡفَعۡ بِالَّتِىۡ هِىَ اَحۡسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ ؕ نَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Idfa' billate hiya ahsanus saiyi'ah; nahnu a'lamu bimaa yasifoon
verses.saheeh: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
verses.khattab: Respond to evil with what is best. We know well what they claim
verses.jalalayn: Ward off with that which is better, that is to say, with the [better] trait of pardoning and shunning them, the evil [act], the hurt they cause you — this was [revealed] before the command to fight [them]. We know best what they allege, [what] they invent of lies and [what they] say and so We will requite them for it.
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Nabi), burayi ko is tareeqe se dafa karo jo behtareen ho jo kuch baatein woh tumpar banate hain woh humein khoob maloom hai

verses.uthmani: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
verses.indopak: وَقُلْ رَّبِّ اَعُوۡذُ بِكَ مِنۡ هَمَزٰتِ الشَّيٰطِيۡنِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wa qur Rabbi a'oozu bika min hamazaatish Shayaateen
verses.saheeh: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
verses.khattab: And say, “My Lord! I seek refuge in You from the temptations of the devils
verses.jalalayn: And say: ‘My Lord, I seek protection in You from the promptings of devils, [from] their [evil] suggestions, which they whisper.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur dua karo ke “parwardigar, main shayateen ki uksahaton(waswason) se teri panaah maangta hoon

verses.uthmani: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
verses.indopak: وَاَعُوۡذُ بِكَ رَبِّ اَنۡ يَّحۡضُرُوۡنِ
verses.transliteration: Wa a'oozu bika Rabbi ai-yahduroon
verses.saheeh: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
verses.khattab: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, that they ˹even˺ come near me.”
verses.jalalayn: And I seek protection in You, my Lord, lest they visit me’, in any of my affairs, for they only visit to bring ill.
verses.romanUrdu: Balke aey mere Rubb, main to issey bhi teri panaah maanga hoon ke woh mere paas aayein”

verses.uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
verses.indopak: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءَ اَحَدَهُمُ الۡمَوۡتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارۡجِعُوۡنِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'a ahada humul mawtu qaala Rabbir ji'oon
verses.saheeh: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
verses.khattab: When death approaches any of them, they cry, “My Lord! Let me go back
verses.jalalayn: Until (hattā is for inceptiveness) when death comes to one of them, and he sees his place in the Fire and his [would-be] place in Paradise, had he been a believer, he says, ‘My Lord! Send me back (arji‘ūn, the plural [person] is [used] to indicate the gravity [of the plea]),
verses.romanUrdu: (yeh log apni karni se baaz na aayenge) yahan tak ke jab in mein se kisi ko maut aa jayegi to kehna shuru kardega ke “Aey mere Rubb, mujhey usi duniya mein wapas bhej dijiye jisey main chodh aaya hoon

verses.uthmani: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَٰلِحًۭا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.indopak: لَعَلِّىۡۤ اَعۡمَلُ صَالِحًـا فِيۡمَا تَرَكۡتُ ؕ كَلَّا ؕ اِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآٮِٕلُهَا ؕ وَمِنۡ وَّرَآٮِٕهِمۡ بَرۡزَخٌ اِلٰى يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: La'alleee a'malu saalihan feemaa taraktu kallaa; innahaa kalimatun huwa qaaa'iluhaa wa minw waraaa'him barzakhun ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon
verses.saheeh: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
verses.khattab: so I may do good in what I left behind.” Never! It is only a ˹useless˺ appeal they make. And there is a barrier behind them until the Day they are resurrected
verses.jalalayn: that I might act righteously, by witnessing that ‘there is no god but God’, that this might be, in that which I have left behind’, [in what] I have wasted of my life, in other words [that this affirmation might be] in its place. God, exalted be He, says: By no means!, that is, there shall be no return. It, namely, [the statement] ‘My Lord! Send me back’, is merely a word that he speaks, but [a word] in which there is no benefit for him; and behind them, ahead of them, there is a barrier, which prevents them from going back [to this world], until the day when they are raised, after which [day] there will be no more return.
verses.romanUrdu: Umeed hai ke ab main neik amal karunga”. Hargiz nahin, yeh to bas ek baat hai jo woh bakk raha hai. Ab in sab (marne waalon) ke peechey ek barzakh (barrier) hayal hai dusri zindagi ke din tak

verses.uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِى الصُّوۡرِ فَلَاۤ اَنۡسَابَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ وَّلَا يَتَسَآءَلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Fa izaa nufikha fis Soori falaaa ansaaba bainahum yawma'izinw wa laa yatasaaa'aloon
verses.saheeh: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
verses.khattab: Then, when the Trumpet will be blown, there will be no kinship between them on that Day, nor will they ˹even care to˺ ask about one another
verses.jalalayn: And when the Trumpet is blown, the Horn, at the first or second blast, there will be no more ties [of kinship] between them on that day, for them to boast of among themselves, nor will they question one another, about such [ties], in contrast to their state in the life of this world, because of the gravity of the situation that will distract them from such [questioning] at certain points during the [Day of] Resurrection. At other [points] they are awake and [as is stated] in one verse: Some of them will turn to others, questioning each other [Q. 37:50].
verses.romanUrdu: Phir junhi ke Sur (trumphet) phoonk diya gaya, unke darmiyan phir koi rishta na rahega aur na woh ek dusre ko puchenge

verses.uthmani: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.indopak: فَمَنۡ ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَازِيۡنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Faman saqulat mawaazee nuhoo fa ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon
verses.saheeh: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
verses.khattab: As for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺, it is they who will be successful
verses.jalalayn: Then those whose scales are heavy, with good deeds, they are the successful, the winners;
verses.romanUrdu: Us waqt jinke padle (scales) bhari hongey wahi falaah payenge

verses.uthmani: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَازِيۡنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ الَّذِيۡنَ خَسِرُوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ فِىۡ جَهَـنَّمَ خٰلِدُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Wa man khaffat mawaa zeenuhoo fa ulaaa'ikal lazeena khasiroon anfusahum fee Jahannnama khaalidoon
verses.saheeh: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
verses.khattab: But those whose scale is light, they will have doomed themselves, staying in Hell forever
verses.jalalayn: and those whose scales are light, because of evil deeds, they are the ones who have lost their souls, and so they will be, abiding in Hell.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jinke padle (scales) halke honge wahi log hongey jinhon ne apne aap ko ghatay mein daal liya. Woh jahannum mein hamesha rahenge

verses.uthmani: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
verses.indopak: تَلۡفَحُ وُجُوۡهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا كٰلِحُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Talfahu wujoohahumun Naaru wa hum feehaa kaalihood
verses.saheeh: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
verses.khattab: The Fire will burn their faces, leaving them deformed
verses.jalalayn: The Fire will scorch their faces, it will burn them, while they glower therein, their upper and lower lips having receded from their teeth, and it will be said to them:
verses.romanUrdu: Aag unke chehron ki khaal chaat jayegi aur unke jabde (jaws) bahar nikal aayenge

verses.uthmani: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.indopak: اَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ اٰيٰتِىۡ تُتۡلٰى عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنۡتُمۡ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Alam takun Aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum bihaa tukazziboon
verses.saheeh: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
verses.khattab: ˹It will be said,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, but you used to deny them?”
verses.jalalayn: ‘Were not My signs, in the Qur'an, recited to you, were you [not] threatened therewith, and you used to deny them?’
verses.romanUrdu: “kya tum wahi log nahin ho ke meri aayat tumhein sunayi jati thi to tum unhein jhutlate thay?”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًۭا ضَآلِّينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتۡ عَلَيۡنَا شِقۡوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوۡمًا ضَآلِّيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo Rabbanaa ghalabat 'alainaa shiqwatunaa wa kunnaa qawman daaalleen
verses.saheeh: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
verses.khattab: They will cry, “Our Lord! Our ill-fate took hold of us, so we became a misguided people
verses.jalalayn: They will say, ‘Our Lord, our wretchedness (shiqwatunā: a variant reading has shaqāwatunā, both of which are verbal nouns with the same meaning) overcame us, and we were an erring folk, [astray] from guidance.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh kahenge “aey hamare Rubb, hamari badbakhti hum par chaa gayi thi, hum waqayi gumraah log thay

verses.uthmani: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ
verses.indopak: رَبَّنَاۤ اَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡهَا فَاِنۡ عُدۡنَا فَاِنَّا ظٰلِمُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Rabbanaa akhrijnaa minhaa fa in 'udnaa fa innaa zaalimoon
verses.saheeh: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
verses.khattab: Our Lord! Take us out of this ˹Fire˺. Then if we ever return ˹to denial˺, we will truly be wrongdoers.”
verses.jalalayn: Our Lord, bring us out of it! Then, if we revert, to disobedience, we will indeed be evildoers’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aey parwardigar, ab humein yahan se nikaal de phir hum aisa kasoor karein to zaalim hongey”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اخۡسَـُٔـوۡا فِيۡهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُوۡنِ
verses.transliteration: Qaalakh sa'oo feehaa wa laa tukallimoon
verses.saheeh: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
verses.khattab: Allah will respond, “Be despised in there! Do not ˹ever˺ plead with Me ˹again˺
verses.jalalayn: He will say, to them by the tongue of a Keeper [of Hell], whose proportion is twice the size of this world: ‘Begone in it, away with you in the Fire, despicable [as you are], and do not speak to Me, about relieving you from the chastisement — so that [all] their hope is extinguished.
verses.romanUrdu: Allah taala jawab dega “ door ho mere saamne se, padey raho isi mein aur mujhse baat na karo

verses.uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ فَرِيۡقٌ مِّنۡ عِبَادِىۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَـنَا وَارۡحَمۡنَا وَاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَ ۖ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Innahoo kaana fareequm min 'ibaadee yaqooloona Rabbanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa Anta khairur raahimeen
verses.saheeh: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
verses.khattab: Indeed, there was a group of My servants who used to pray, ‘Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the best of those who show mercy,’
verses.jalalayn: Indeed there was a party of My servants — namely, the Emigrants — who would say, “Our Lord, we believe; therefore forgive us, and have mercy on us, for You are the best of the merciful”.
verses.romanUrdu: Tum wahi log to ho ke mere kuch banday jab kehte thay ke aye hamare parwardigar, hum iman laye, humein maaf karde, humpar reham kar, tu sab raheemon se accha raheem hai

verses.uthmani: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاتَّخَذۡتُمُوۡهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا حَتّٰٓى اَنۡسَوۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرِىۡ وَكُنۡتُمۡ مِّنۡهُمۡ تَضۡحَكُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Fattakhaztumoohum sikhriyyan hattaaa ansawkum zikree wa kuntum minhum tadhakoon
verses.saheeh: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
verses.khattab: but you were ˹so busy˺ making fun of them that it made you forget My remembrance. And you used to laugh at them
verses.jalalayn: But then you took them as an object of ridicule (read sukhriyyan or sikhriyyan, a verbal noun meaning ‘mockery’). Among those [ridiculed] were Bilāl [al-Habashī], Suhayb [al-Rūmī], ‘Ammār [b. Yāsir] and Salmān [al-Fārisī]; until they made you forget My remembrance, which you disregarded, as you were engaged in deriding them. Thus these [men] were the cause of the forgetting, which is why this [act] has been attributed to them, and you used to laugh at them.
verses.romanUrdu: To tumne unka mazaaq bana liye, yahan tak ke unki zidd ne tumhein yeh bhi bhula diya ke main bhi koi hoon, aur tum unpar haste rahey

verses.uthmani: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنِّىۡ جَزَيۡتُهُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡۤا ۙ اَنَّهُمۡ هُمُ الۡفَآٮِٕزُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Inee jazaituhumul Yawma bimaa sabarooo annahum humul faaa'izoon
verses.saheeh: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
verses.khattab: Today I have indeed rewarded them for their perseverance: they are certainly the triumphant.”
verses.jalalayn: Indeed I have rewarded them this day, abiding bliss, for the endurance they showed, while you mocked them and caused them hurt. They are indeed the winners’, of what they sought (read innahum as [indicating] a new sentence, or annahum as [indicating] a second direct object of the [verb] jazaytuhum, ‘I have rewarded them’).
verses.romanUrdu: Aaj unke us sabr ka maine yeh phal diya hai ke wahi kamiyaab hain”

verses.uthmani: قَٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
verses.indopak: قٰلَ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِى الۡاَرۡضِ عَدَدَ سِنِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala kam labistum fil ardi 'adada sineen
verses.saheeh: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
verses.khattab: He will ask ˹them˺, “How many years did you remain on earth?”
verses.jalalayn: He, exalted be He, will say, to them by the tongue of a Keeper [of Hell] (a variant reading [for qāla, ‘He will say’] has qul, ‘say’): ‘How long did you tarry in the earth, in this world and in your graves, in years?’ (‘adada sinīna is a specification).
verses.romanUrdu: Phir Allah taala unse puchega “batao,zameen mein tum kitne saal rahey?”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡا لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا اَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمٍ فَسۡــَٔـلِ الۡعَآدِّيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo labisnaa yawman aw ba'da yawmin fas'alil 'aaaddeen
verses.saheeh: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
verses.khattab: They will reply, “We remained ˹only˺ a day or part of a day. But ask those who kept count.”
verses.jalalayn: They will say, ‘We tarried a day, or part of a day — they are uncertain thereof, deeming it shorter [than what it was] because of the gravity of the chastisement they are suffering. Yet ask those who keep count!’, namely, [ask] the angels who number the deeds of [all] creatures.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh kahenge “ ek din ya din ka bhi kuch hissa hum wahan thehre hain, shumaar karne walon se pooch lijiye”

verses.uthmani: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: قٰلَ اِنۡ لَّبِثۡـتُمۡ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا لَّوۡ اَنَّكُمۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala il labistum illaa qaleelal law annakum kuntum ta'lamoon
verses.saheeh: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
verses.khattab: He will say, “You only remained for a little while, if only you knew
verses.jalalayn: He, exalted, will say, to them, also by the tongue of Keeper [of Hell] (a variant reading [for qāla, ‘He will say’] has qul, ‘say’): ‘You tarried but a little, if only you knew, the length of time you tarried, [you would have realised that it is] trivial relative to how long you will tarry in the Fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Irshad hoga “ thodi hi dair thehre ho na, kaash tumne yeh us waqt jana hota

verses.uthmani: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.indopak: اَفَحَسِبۡتُمۡ اَنَّمَا خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ عَبَثًا وَّاَنَّكُمۡ اِلَيۡنَا لَا تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Afahsibtum annamaa khalaqnaakum 'abasanw wa annakum ilainaa laa turja'oon
verses.saheeh: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
verses.khattab: Did you then think that We had created you without purpose, and that you would never be returned to Us?”
verses.jalalayn: Did you suppose that We created you aimlessly, and not for an underlying reason, and that you would not be returned to Us?’ (read active tarji‘ūna, ‘you [would not] return’, or passive turja‘ūna, ‘you [would not] be returned’) Nay! But [it was] so that We might enthral you with commands and prohibitions, where after you would be returned to Us for Us to requite [you] accordingly: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except that they may worship Me [Q. 51:56].
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tumne yeh samajh rakkha tha ke humne tumhein fizul(bekar) hi paida kiya hai aur tumhein hamari taraf kabhi palatna hi nahin hai?”

verses.uthmani: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.indopak: فَتَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ الۡمَلِكُ الۡحَـقُّ ۚ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ۚ رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡـكَرِيۡمِ
verses.transliteration: Fata'aalal laahul Malikul Haqq; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil Kareem
verses.saheeh: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
verses.khattab: Exalted is Allah, the True King! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, the Lord of the Honourable Throne
verses.jalalayn: So exalted be God, above aimless action and other such things that do not befit Him, the King, the Truth! There is no god except Him, the Lord of the Noble Throne (‘arsh), the throne (kursī), which is a seat [similar to a king’s] that is exquisite.
verses.romanUrdu: Pas baala o bartar hai Allah , baadshah e haqiqi, koi khuda uske siwa nahin, maalik hai arsh e buzurg ka

verses.uthmani: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَنۡ يَّدۡعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ ۙ لَا بُرۡهَانَ لَهٗ بِهٖ ۙ فَاِنَّمَا حِسَابُهٗ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهٖ ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُفۡلِحُ الۡـكٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa mai yad'u ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara laa burhaana lahoo bihee fa innnamaa hisaabuhoo 'inda Rabbih; innahoo laa yuflihul kaafiroon
verses.saheeh: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
verses.khattab: Whoever invokes, besides Allah, another god—for which they can have no proof—they will surely find their penalty with their Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed
verses.jalalayn: And he who calls on another god along with God has no proof thereof (lā burhāna lahu bihi, an [extra] explicative adjectival qualification that has no [other syntactical] signification), his reckoning, his requital, will indeed be with his Lord. Truly the disbelievers will not be successful, they will not be felicitous.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jo koi Allah ke saath kisi aur maabood ko pukare, jiske liye uske paas koi daleel nahin, to uska hisaab uske Rubb ke paas hai. Aisey kafir kabhi falaah nahin paa sakte

verses.uthmani: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَقُلْ رَّبِّ اغۡفِرۡ وَارۡحَمۡ وَاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa qur Rabbigh fir warham wa Anta khairur raahimeen
verses.saheeh: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.”
verses.jalalayn: And say: ‘My Lord, forgive and have mercy, on believers — [this] ‘mercy’ adds to the ‘forgiveness’ [in terms of God’s grace] — and You are the best of the merciful’, the most excellent of those who have mercy.
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Muhammad) kaho, “Mere Rubb darguzar farma, aur reham kar, aur tu sab raheemon se accha raheem hai”
